description: In dns_cache.rs, Bucket::get calls self.map.lock(), then does map.get(&key) to check existence and retrieve the value, and if the TTL is expired calls map.remove(&key). This is either one or two hash lookups. Using the entry API (map.entry(key)) would allow a single lookup that either removes stale entries or returns the value. At high DNS lookup rates (busy relay queue) this doubles the hash work per cache check. Fix: use entry().and_modify() or get() + remove() only on the stale path, replacing with a single HashMap::get() that avoids the double lookup on the hot (cache-hit, non-stale) path.
title: smtp: DnsCache bucket performs two hash lookups per get
